record_kind: Source-backed negative model-learning/curation experiment lesson; not a motor policy

hypothesis.NN_learning_goal: A trained residual response model improves held-tool translation prediction over raw-input constant velocity.
hypothesis.curation_goal: Obtained-experience priority sampling improves the same NN over equal-count uniform sampling.

applicability.robot: Same simulated Panda + adapted Shadow right wrist/hand and task-specific state schemas
applicability.input: Full privileged qpos/qvel including object truth, current control and retrospective mean/last executed controls, interval dt/tick count and masks/task onehot; no image or language input
applicability.output: One interval held-tool world XYZ displacement in metres, usually about0.1s; no robot commands
applicability.control_scope: Recorded executed controls evaluated; helper accepts supplied planned controls but planning/execution/closed-loop performance unvalidated

comparison_contract.candidate_acquisition: Shared engineering-reference-controller pool; native experience lessons informed experiment design, not autonomous acquisition of this pool
comparison_contract.execution_authentication: Frozen source/weights/snapshot metadata consistency; not independent external attestation of historical optimizer execution
comparison_contract.primary_metric: Mean of per-episode mean L2 physical displacement error in mm; NN arm summaries average3trainingseeds
comparison_contract.sampling_label_use: V3 uses complete obtained TRAIN displacement labels to rank ||Y-CV||; not label-free and no acquisition/label-cost reduction

rounds.method: TRAIN-CV-error priorities and CV-residual learning with validation checkpoint fallback

measured_outcome.V3_validation_identity: 3original3000validation cases +6oldV1final4000/4001 cases; original acquisition study/partition preserved and current known-validation role explicit

workflow_action.meaning: Reusable input/output, integrity-check and fallback workflow only; selected9NN exports equal untrained CV and do not establish learned or motor-skill improvement
workflow_action.input_encoder: model_input.encode_state_action(schema, task, qpos, qvel, current_ctrl, controls, dt)
workflow_action.released_fixture: Known fixed x/y/velocity/dt examples; demo parity is not fresh generalization

data_and_quality.large_raw_files: Original model.mjb, samples.npz and per-tick control streams remain local in runs/experience-learning-v1; not distributed in the small portable package
data_and_quality.hammer_missing_value_interpretation: Unknown/not retained in outcome summary, never zero
data_and_quality.quality_gates: Original task outcomes are retained; force/penetration remain diagnostics rather than post-hoc relabeling gates
data_and_quality.task_success_interpretation: Physical outcomes belong to engineering reference controllers, never model-control success rates

reusable_lessons.condition: Validation selects the untrained zero residual checkpoint
reusable_lessons.guidance: Label exact CV fallback explicitly; preserve trained nonselected checkpoints and reject a learned-gain claim.

reusable_lessons.condition: Experience-priority and equal-count uniform models produce the same final prediction
reusable_lessons.guidance: Report zero curation gain separately from baseline response accuracy; a reproducible workflow is not evidence for the learning hypothesis.

reusable_lessons.condition: Reusing prior final examples as known validation
reusable_lessons.guidance: Preserve actual acquisition study/partition and declare the new analysis role; do not call those cases fresh or multiply correlated seeds.

reusable_lessons.condition: Large TRAIN residuals identify candidate rows
reusable_lessons.guidance: Disclose obtained-label use and shared candidate costs; preserve high-force/penetration failures rather than claiming they are expert-quality experience.

reusable_lessons.condition: Float32 checkpoint metrics differ at sub-nanometre aggregate scale
reusable_lessons.guidance: Use the existing documented parity tolerance, retain strict initial flags, and keep exact zero-step/final-CV checks; do not interpret rounding as a learning effect.

provenance.interpretation_author: Codex, derived from saved sources/results and independent checks; not automatic motor-skill discovery
provenance.hash_scope: The linked frozen audit/source/package manifests retain all leaf input hashes; this reusable card avoids duplicating those large ledgers.

closed_study.claim: Engineering data/validation/capability workflow delivered; NN-learning and experience-curation benefit hypotheses not supported.
